title: Renewal Timing and Reminder Settings for Certificate Subscriptions
content:
The renewals team applies the same renewal timing and reminder settings to every subscription of SSL/TLS Certificates. The settings table below shows each setting for every Harborline certificate product.

| Certificate product | Days before the subscription end date from which a renewal may be bought | Date a renewal extends the subscription from | Auto-renew on by default | Days before the subscription end date on which the auto-renew charge is attempted | Days before the subscription end date on which reminder emails are sent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 90 | the subscription end date | Yes | 30 | 30, 7 and 1 |

All three day figures are counted back from the subscription end date, and a renewal extends the subscription from that end date.

## Hypothetical calendar

*A hypothetical subscription of any product ending on 14 October 2033, shown only to place the settings on a calendar.*

| Setting | Days before the end date | Calendar date |
|---|---|---|
| First day a renewal may be bought | 90 | 16 July 2033 |
| Auto-renew charge attempted | 30 | 14 September 2033 |
| Reminder emails | 30, 7 and 1 | 14 September, 7 October and 13 October 2033 |
| Date a renewal extends the subscription from | — | 14 October 2033 |

Auto-renew is on by default for every product; the auto-renew charge date and the reminder dates above are the same for all seven products.
